QuestInfo.name: [Twilight Perion] Public Opinion
QuestInfo.0: The nightmares are sweeping across all of Maple World. You need to find a way to assuage the public's fears. Talk to #bAthena Pierce#k.
QuestInfo.1: According to Athena Pierce, the people in Perion are having a different nightmare than the other areas. Go to Perion and meet #bDances with Balrog#k in #bWarriors' Sanctuary#k.
QuestInfo.2: You went to Perion and met with Dances with Balrog in the Warriors' Sanctuary.

no.0: Only competent Maplers can complete this task. You might need a little more training...

yes.0: I'm glad you're here. We have much to discuss, but allow me some time to convene with the ancestors before we begin.

npc.0: If you meet Perion's sage, #bDances with Balrog#k, in the #bWarriors' Sanctuary#k, he will explain things to you.
